sloka: शूरो धीमान् रथी खड्गी रथप्रवरमास्थितः।हत्वा दशरथिं रामं भवान् प्राप्स्यति मैथिलीम् ।। ६.९३.६६ ।।
transliteration: śūro dhīmān rathī khaḍgī rathapravaramāsthitaḥ।hatvā daśarathiṁ rāmaṁ bhavān prāpsyati maithilīm ।। 6.93.66 ।।

translations.english: "Today being the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, start on the next day that is the fifteenth dark day surrounded by the army and win."
